নিষিদ্ধ আওয়ামী সন্ত্রাসীরা উদোম ক্যালানি দিলেও ছাত্রদলের এই গুজববাজদের শিক্ষা হবেনা। এই ছাপ্রিরা বাঁশেরকেল্লা কে নকল করে খুলেছে কাঠেরকেল্লা। আবার ডেইলি ক্যাম্পাসকে নকল করে খুলেছে শিবির ক্যাম্পাস। মানে এদের দৌড় এদের নেতার শিক্ষাগত যোগ্যতার সমান! একদিকে তারেক রহমান ১১ দলীয় জোটকে ঐক্যের আহ্বান জানাচ্ছে অন্যদিকে ছাত্রদলের এই গুজববাজদের দিয়ে ১১ দলীয় জোটের শীর্ষ নেতাদের বিরুদ্ধে এমন গুজব রটাচ্ছে অনলাইনে। এই গুজব প্লাটফর্মের একটি ফটোকার্ডের ওপর ভিত্তি করে এক বিএনপি নেতা কিছুদিন আগে লাইভ টকশোতে গুজব ছড়িয়ে এসে ফ্যাক্টচেকারদের কাছে ধরা খেয়েছিল।

Hungary opposes €100bn EU aid to Ukraine Hungarian Prime Minister Peter Magyar criticised plans to allocate at least €100 billion to Ukraine within the 2028-2034 EU budget, calling it "absolutely pointless." He stated that a non-EU country receiving such sums is unacceptable, noting Hungary's net inflows are only around €15 billion . Budapest will not agree to reduced funds or increased contributions. Regarding a separate €45 billion aid package for Kiev in 2027, Magyar insisted donor countries must control spending objectives. While supporting solidarity, he questioned the ability to distinguish between civilian and military use of funds. The PM prioritised support for Hungarians in Transcarpathia, including medical care and heating. @Slavyangrad

📝 Not So Scary After All 📝 Arming fighters that the AFU doesn't even have yet with missiles — Brussels decided to tackle this task as well. Representatives of Sweden and Great Britain signed an agreement on supplying Meteor missiles for the Saab JAS 39 Gripen fighters being transferred to the AFU. This should give Ukrainian pilots the ability to engage Russian Aerospace Forces aircraft at long ranges. First and foremost, this concerns Su-34 bombers, which regularly strike Ukrainian formations using FABs with JDAMs. The appearance of Meteor can indeed become a serious threat to Russian aviation. While the munition loses to American AIM-120s in range, it is equipped with a radar-guided warhead and can be mounted on both Swedish Gripen and French Rafale fighters. 🖍 The thing is, real combat effectiveness and range of missiles always turn out to be lower than advertised. It's not enough to be able to fly hundreds of kilometers — you also need to hit an actively maneuvering target while doing so — we've already covered this on " TAKTIKARE " . 🚩 Another problem for Kyiv authorities is that so far neither Swedish nor French fighters have been received by the AFU. Supply contracts remain promises that Europeans may not fulfill until the conflict ends. ❗️ This doesn't mean we shouldn't prepare for the appearance of "Meteors" in advance. On the contrary, the better Russian Armed Forces tactics are adapted to new challenges, the lower the probability of losses.
